files.README.md:
# Quillmere Bindery - edition handover

Each edition is handed over on a shared remote that deletes the branch ref of a run once the run is closed.
The commands the bindery keeps are carded in vcs/prune-cards.tsv.
files.notes/stale-review.txt:
Review notes:
Closed runs have their branch refs deleted on the shared remote at handover.
The local checkout still lists the refs of runs closed weeks ago, and the reviewer wants
those stale entries gone without touching any local branch.

turns.prompt: Quillmere Bindery reads each closed run from a shared remote that deletes the branch ref of a run once the run is handed over. The local checkout still lists refs for runs that were closed weeks ago and they clutter the review. Give the fetch option that removes the remote-tracking refs the remote itself has dropped. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
